description: Loop Controller Node Template for Flowise
purpose: Generic loop controller for iterative workflows with retry logic, validation loops, and approval-with-revision patterns

data.label: Loop Control
data.name: conditionAgentAgentflow
data.description: Generic loop controller: Continue ↺, Exit (Approved/Validated), Exit (Max Iterations), or Escalate to Human.

inputs.conditionAgentInstructions:
You are the Loop Controller for enterprise workflows (promotion, validation, refinement). Decide ONE route:

ROUTES
0 = CONTINUE (loop back for revision/correction)
1 = EXIT: APPROVED/VALIDATED (success)
2 = EXIT: MAX ITERATIONS (stop with failure)
3 = ESCALATE TO HUMAN (handoff required)

SIGNALS (from input JSON):
- iteration_count (int)
- max_iterations (int)
- approval_state (e.g., PENDING, REJECTED, APPROVED)
- validation_errors (array)
- quality_score (0-100)
- required_fields_missing (bool)
- notes/comments (string)
- exit_on_approval_states (array of strings)

LOGIC (deterministic, then judgement):
- If approval_state ∈ exit_on_approval_states → route 1
- Else if iteration_count >= max_iterations → route 2
- Else if validation_errors present OR required_fields_missing OR quality_score < 80 OR approval_state == "REJECTED" → route 0
- Else if ambiguous/blocker needing human decision (e.g., policy conflict, missing policy mapping) → route 3
- Otherwise → route 0

Return ONLY a compact JSON object: {"route": <0|1|2|3>, "reason": "..."}. No extra text.

conditionAgentScenarios.scenario: Continue: rejection or failed validation → requestor/agent revises and resubmits
Exit (Max Iterations): safety stop after too many retries
Escalate to Human: ambiguous policy or high-risk decision

prompt_template.name: Loop Controller
prompt_template.description: Decide to continue, exit-success, exit-failure (max iters), or escalate to human.
prompt_template.system: You are a strict loop gate. Output ONLY JSON with fields {"route": <0|1|2|3>, "reason": "..."}. See routes and logic in the instructions.

basic_validation_loop.description: [Validator Agent] → [Loop Node] → [0: Back to Editor Agent] | [1: Continue to Next Stage] | [2: Failure Handler] | [3: Human Review]

approval_with_revision_loop.description: [Submission Agent] → [HIL Approval Gate] → [Reject: Loop Node] → [0: Back to Revision Agent] | [1: Final Approval] | [2: Abandon] | [3: Executive Review]

quality_gate_loop.description: [Quality Check Agent] → [Loop Node] → [0: Back to Builder Agent] | [1: Production Deploy] | [2: Mark Failed] | [3: Manual QA Review]

promotion_nomination_revision.scenario: Manager submits promotion → Rejected by local leadership → Manager revises justification → Resubmit (max 3 times)
promotion_nomination_revision.expected_reason: Rejection detected, manager should revise and resubmit

document_validation_loop.scenario: Document submitted → Validation errors found → User corrects → Re-validate (max 5 times)
document_validation_loop.expected_reason: Validation errors present, user should correct and resubmit

quality_score_iteration.scenario: Code quality check → Score 65/100 → Developer improves → Re-check (max 3 times)
quality_score_iteration.expected_reason: Quality score below threshold (80), developer should improve code

max_iterations_exit.scenario: After 3 failed attempts → Stop and notify failure
max_iterations_exit.expected_reason: Max iterations reached, stopping with failure

approval_success_exit.expected_reason: Approval state is APPROVED, exiting with success

escalate_to_human.scenario: Policy conflict detected → Needs executive decision

loop_context.notes: Conflict: Employee in multiple promotion pools, policy unclear on precedence

escalate_to_human.expected_reason: Ambiguous policy situation requiring human decision

max_iterations.rationale: Prevents infinite loops while allowing reasonable retry attempts

temperature.rationale: Loop decisions must be deterministic and consistent

state_tracking.requirement: MUST track iteration_count in flow state
state_tracking.method: Update state in agent BEFORE loop node
state_tracking.reset: Reset counter when workflow completes successfully

unclear_routing.problem: Ambiguous instructions leading to random routing

missing_escalation.problem: No human escalation path for edge cases
missing_escalation.solution: Always wire output-3 to human review node

no_state_tracking.problem: Iteration count not tracked, loop can't exit

integration_checklist: [ ] Agent before loop node populates loop_context with required fields
[ ] Agent before loop node increments iteration_count in state
[ ] Output 0 (Continue) wired back to revision/correction agent
[ ] Output 1 (Exit Approved) wired to next stage
[ ] Output 2 (Exit Max Iters) wired to failure handler
[ ] Output 3 (Escalate) wired to human review node
[ ] State reset mechanism for successful completion
